newsitem.title: UKRAINE: SOCCER-TEAMS FOR UKRAINE V ARMENIA WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TEAMS FOR UKRAINE V ARMENIA WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.

text.p: Teams for Wednesday's World Cup European zone group nine qualifier between Ukraine and Armenia on Wednesday:

Ukraine - 1-Oleksander Shovkovsky; 2-Oleg Luzhny, 3-Yuri Dmytrulin; 4-Oleksander Golovko; 5-Vladyslav Vaschuk; 6-Dmytro Mykhaylenko; 7-Serhiy Nagornyak; 8-Yuri Kalitvintsev; 9-Vitaly Kosovsky; 10-Andriy Shevchenko, 11-Serhiy Rebrov.

Armenia - 1-Roman Berezovsky; 2-Yervand Sykiasyan, 3-Felix Khodzhoyan, 4-Sarkis Ovsepyan, 5-Michel Ter-Zakarian; 6-Arutyun Vardanyan; 7-Artur Petrosyan; 8-Albert Sarkisyan; 9-Hamlet Mkhitaryan, 10-Eric Assadourian; 11-Karapet Mikaelyan.
